brief:
Families across Gaza confront devastating water shortages that burden children with responsibilities well beyond their years, Al Jazeera English reported. Kids undertake physically demanding tasks to secure clean water and food for their households, often sacrificing schooling and play to help families survive.

The humanitarian conditions have created cascading hardships where children's health and development suffer as they prioritize household survival over education. Water scarcity compounds existing food insecurity in the territory, forcing young people to mature rapidly in an environment where basic necessities remain difficult to obtain. Aid organizations warn that prolonged exposure to such conditions threatens both the immediate wellbeing and long-term prospects of Gaza's youth.
dek: Families in Gaza face devastating water shortages, leaving children with heavy responsibilities beyond their years.
title: Gaza's water crisis forces children into adult labor roles.
